Current rules already provide full capacity eligibility for this window, allowing only to READ that valid material without an additional ASK; the complete ASK-free path still requires personal choice, real application/confirmation writing, person-specific notifications, and follow-up maintenance.

style_rubric.supported: Clearly distinguish between plan requests and confirmations, trips and sessions; cannot guess acceptance based on flexibility
style_rubric.unsupported: Cannot guarantee entering the venue on time after arriving at the station
style_rubric.acceptable: Explain station arrival/walking/venue arrival/deadline separately, preserving uncertainty

critical_violations: Fabricating real ticket changes or ticket issuance
english_edition_language_policy: English edition: all material is rendered in English, and all text you author must be in English. Chinese/English language labels identify the original source-language objects; keep those objects and their separate maintenance obligations distinct. Original language tags are provenance, not an instruction to answer in Chinese. Completion deadlines are inclusive: finishing exactly at the stated cutoff is on time. A prohibition on acting before an effective time still forbids early action.
